<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:id="@+id/bottomNavigationContainer"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="80dp"
    android:orientation="horizontal"
    android:paddingVertical="8dp"
    android:background="@color/background_primary"
    android:elevation="8dp">

    <!-- Навигационен елемент 1 - Драг -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/navDrag"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

        <ImageView
            android:id="@+id/ivNavDrag"
            android:layout_width="24dp"
            android:layout_height="24dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_drag_icon"
            app:tint="@color/nav_icon_inactive"/>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNavDrag"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:text="@string/nav_drag_label"
            android:textColor="@color/nav_text_inactive"
            android:textSize="12sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Навигационен елемент 2 - Писта -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/navTrack"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

        <ImageView
            android:id="@+id/ivNavTrack"
            android:layout_width="24dp"
            android:layout_height="24dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_track"
            app:tint="@color/nav_icon_inactive"/>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNavTrack"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:text="@string/nav_track_label"
            android:textColor="@color/nav_text_inactive"
            android:textSize="12sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Навигационен елемент 3 - Карта -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/navMap"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

        <ImageView
            android:id="@+id/ivNavMap"
            android:layout_width="24dp"
            android:layout_height="24dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_map"
            app:tint="@color/nav_icon_inactive"/>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNavMap"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:minWidth="40dp"
            android:text="@string/nav_map_label"
            android:textColor="@color/nav_text_inactive"
            android:textSize="12sp"
            android:singleLine="true"
            android:ellipsize="none"
            android:maxLines="1"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:includeFontPadding="false"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Навигационен елемент 4 - Гараж -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/navGarage"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

        <ImageView
            android:id="@+id/ivNavGarage"
            android:layout_width="24dp"
            android:layout_height="24dp"
            android:src="@drawable/ic_garage"
            app:tint="@color/nav_icon_inactive"/>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNavGarage"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:text="@string/nav_garage_label"
            android:textColor="@color/nav_text_inactive"
            android:textSize="12sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Навигационен елемент 5 - Настройки -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/navOptions"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="match_parent"
        android:layout_weight="1"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:gravity="center"
        android:clickable="true"
        android:focusable="true"
        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

        <FrameLayout
            android:layout_width="24dp"
            android:layout_height="24dp">

            <ImageView
                android:id="@+id/ivNavOptions"
                android:layout_width="24dp"
                android:layout_height="24dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_settings"
                app:tint="@color/nav_icon_inactive"/>

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvNavOptionsBadge"
                android:layout_width="14dp"
                android:layout_height="14dp"
                android:layout_gravity="top|end"
                android:background="@drawable/bg_settings_alert_badge"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:text="!"
                android:textColor="@android:color/white"
                android:textSize="9sp"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:visibility="gone" />
        </FrameLayout>

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNavOptions"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="4dp"
            android:text="@string/nav_options_label"
            android:textColor="@color/nav_text_inactive"
            android:textSize="12sp"/>
    </LinearLayout>

</LinearLayout>
